hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then git diff --cached --name-only | xargs grep -l 'AKIA\|SECRET_KEY\|password\s*=\|api_key\s*=\|keystore' 2>/dev/null && echo 'BLOCKED: Potential secrets or sensitive files detected in staged files' && exit 1; fi; true

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -Eq '^\s*(flutter|dart) '; then echo 'BLOCKED: Use melos run scripts or fvm-prefixed commands instead of bare flutter/dart. See CLAUDE.md §Command Priority.'; exit 1; fi; true

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git commit'; then git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '(env\.json|config_stage\.json|config_prod\.json)' && echo 'BLOCKED: Unencrypted config file detected in staged files — use encrypted variants.' && exit 1; fi; true
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(g|freezed|gr)\.dart$ ]]; then echo "BLOCKED: Never edit generated files manually ($CLAUDE_FILE_PATH) — run melos run build instead."; exit 1; fi; true
/Users/anderscheow/.local/bin/graphify hook-check

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git worktree add'; then WORKTREE_PATH=$(git worktree list --porcelain | grep '^worktree' | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}'); if [[ -n "$WORKTREE_PATH" ]] && [[ -d "$WORKTREE_PATH" ]]; then FVM_VERSION=$(grep -oE '[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+' "$WORKTREE_PATH/.fvmrc" 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo "Setting up new worktree at $WORKTREE_PATH (Flutter $FVM_VERSION)..."; cd "$WORKTREE_PATH" && fvm use "$FVM_VERSION" && melos run get && melos run intl && melos run build && melos run fluttergen && echo 'Worktree setup complete.'; fi; fi; true
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]]; then fvm dart format "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fvm dart analyze "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]] && [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" =~ /application/|/domain/|/infrastructure/dto/|/infrastructure/ds/|/shared/providers|_page\.dart$|app_router\.dart$ ]]; then echo 'Codegen-relevant file changed — running build...'; melos run build; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */assets/translations/en.json ]]; then echo 'Translation file changed — running intl...'; melos run intl; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */assets/* ]] && [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" != */translations/* ]]; then echo 'Asset added — running fluttergen...'; melos run fluttergen; fi
if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */pubspec.yaml ]]; then echo 'pubspec.yaml changed — running get + license...'; melos run get && melos run license; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.yaml ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.json ]]; then if grep -qiE 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|password\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]+["\x27]|api_key\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]+["\x27]|secret\s*=\s*["\x27][^"\x27]+["\x27]' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: Potential hardcoded secret detected in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH — review before committing."; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *_page.dart ]]; then PAGE_CLASS=$(grep -oE 'class [A-Za-z]+Page' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | head -1 | awk '{print $2}'); if [[ -n "$PAGE_CLASS" ]]; then ROUTER="$(dirname "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" | sed 's|/screens.*||')/ui/routes/app_router.dart"; if [[ -f "$ROUTER" ]] && ! grep -q "$PAGE_CLASS" "$ROUTER"; then echo "WARNING: $PAGE_CLASS is not registered in app_router.dart — add it to @AutoRouterConfig routes."; fi; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]]; then if grep -qE '^\s*print\(' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: print() detected in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH — use a logger or guard with kDebugMode before releasing."; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */screens/**/*.dart ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */screens/*.dart ]]; then if grep -qE "Text\(['\"][^'\"]{3,}['\"]" "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: Possible hardcoded user-visible string in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH — add to assets/translations/en.json and use LocaleKeys."; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */screens/**/*.dart ]] || [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == */screens/*.dart ]]; then if grep -qE 'on(Pressed|Tap|Changed|Submitted)[^}]*ref\.watch' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null; then echo "WARNING: ref.watch inside event handler detected in $CLAUDE_FILE_PATH — use ref.read instead (CLAUDE.md §5)."; fi; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" == *.dart ]]; then if ! command -v python3 &>/dev/null; then brew install python; fi; python3 '/Users/anderscheow/Documents/Git-Projects/Flutter/flutter_calorie_quest/.codex/hooks/sort_dart_method_order.py' 2>/dev/null; fi; true
bash '/Users/anderscheow/Documents/Git-Projects/Flutter/flutter_calorie_quest/.codex/hooks/prune_gone_branches.sh'
echo '\n--- Session Analysis ---'; fvm dart analyze lib/ 2>&1 | tail -20
CHANGED=$(git diff --name-only); if [[ -n "$CHANGED" ]]; then echo '\n--- Files changed this session ---'; git diff --stat HEAD; fi
UNSTAGED=$(git diff --name-only); if [[ -n "$UNSTAGED" ]]; then echo "\nReminder: You have unstaged changes — review with 'git diff' before committing."; fi
echo '\n--- Formatting lib/ ---'; melos run format 2>/dev/null; true
